message_types.name: RawTagRead
message_types.description: Unified semantic RFID tag read event normalized from heterogeneous commercial readers (Zebra, Hopeland, Chafon, Marktrace)

properties.name: antenna
properties.description: Antenna port number (1-8) that captured the tag

properties.name: rssi
properties.description: Received Signal Strength Indicator in dBm

properties.name: read_count
properties.description: Number of reads during this report cycle

properties.name: dock_portal
properties.description: Subpath or logistics dock location (e.g. rfid/hopeland/dock1)

message_types.name: ReaderHealthAlert
message_types.description: Diagnostic alert emitted when a reader or antenna exhibits anomalous RF behavior or extreme signal degradation

properties.name: details
properties.description: Human-readable description of the RF anomaly
